title: eludite.browser.evaluate input
description: Run JavaScript in a tab's page (Runtime.evaluate in the main frame) and answer its value as JSON: promises are awaited by default, objects come back by value. Strings longer than `max_chars` (default 10000) are cut, and so is the JSON text of a larger value, with `truncated: true`. A thrown exception fails the command with its message and stack. It runs with the page's privileges and can change the page, so prefer eludite.browser.read_page, find and page_text for reading. Permission class execute; the solution policy's `browser.evaluate` can make it dangerous (`prompt`, which prompts) or refuse it (`deny`) (ADR-0009). Fails with "no tab" when the browser has no tab: call eludite.browser.tab_open first.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when the solution's policy sets `browser.evaluate` to `prompt`; refused for agents when it is `deny`.

return_by_value.description: Answer objects and arrays as JSON (default true). false: answer the value's description (`HTMLDivElement`, `Array(3)`).

max_chars.description: The longest string, or JSON text, to answer (default 10000).

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
